title: ui-locked: compose LockedPhase component
description: Compose the LockedPhase component that presents the final state of Progressive Discover. Integrates completion summary, artifact browser, and workflow actions (export, share, restart) into a cohesive completion experience.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL render locked phase with complete summary and actions
THE SYSTEM SHALL provide workflow completion actions

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL display completion summary with export and restart actions
THE SYSTEM SHALL generate and download the compiled artifacts
THE SYSTEM SHALL reset workflow and return to initial phase

unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT immediately discard compiled artifacts
THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT silently fail without user notification
unwanted.because: Users need to know when exports are unsuccessful

preconditions: Completion summary component must be ready
Workflow reset handler must be defined
postconditions: Locked phase shows complete summary with all actions
Restart clears state and returns to beginning
invariants: Summary remains visible until user action
Export can be triggered multiple times

happy: Given locked phase is active, when component renders, then summary and action buttons are visible
Given user clicks export, when export completes, then file downloads to user's system
Given user clicks restart, when confirmation is accepted, then workflow resets to initial state
error: Given export fails, when user clicks export, then error message is shown with retry option
Given restart confirmation declined, when user cancels, then workflow remains in locked phase
Given summary data corrupted, when locked phase renders, then graceful error state is displayed
